findings.title: queued timestamp is evaluated once at import time
findings.body: In a dataclass, default values are evaluated when the class is defined, not per instance. `queued: datetime = timezone.now()` stamps every `AssignmentSource` created without an explicit `queued` with the module import time. `from_integration` does not pass `queued`, so all sources created via inbound sync share a stale creation/queue timestamp; any future use for ordering, TTL, or queue delay will be wrong. Use `field(default_factory=timezone.now)` after importing `field`.

findings.title: Source guard suppresses outbound sync for all issues on the same integration
findings.body: `should_sync` returns `False` whenever `sync_source.integration_id` matches the target integration. The outbound path enumerates every `ExternalIssue` linked to the group (`sync_group_assignee_outbound`), and a group can be linked to multiple issues in the same integration or across org integrations. An inbound assignment from one external issue will therefore skip outbound assignment to every other linked issue in that integration, not just the originating issue; those linked issue trackers silently remain out of sync. The source should carry a more specific identifier (for example, org integration id and external issue id) and the guard should compare narrowly.

findings.title: Outbound task always passes new arguments to overridable integration methods
findings.body: The task now calls `installation.should_sync("outbound_assignee", parsed_assignment_source)` and later `installation.sync_assignee_outbound(..., assignment_source=parsed_assignment_source)`, even when no source exists (the argument is `None`). The base `should_sync` signature was updated, but concrete integration subclasses that override the old one-argument `should_sync` or define `sync_assignee_outbound` without `assignment_source`/`**kwargs` were valid before and will now raise `TypeError`. This can break assignee outbound sync for those integrations on every task, not just the new inbound source path. All concrete overrides need to be updated or call sites made backward-compatible.
